data.title: 菲伦 · 王都舞会
data.description: 灯火辉煌的王都宫廷舞厅内，换上华丽露肩晚礼服的菲伦在悠扬的华尔兹乐曲中轻轻提起裙摆，向你微微欠身施礼，紫眸中泛着少见的娇美——「我并不擅长跳舞，如果踩到您的脚……请务必提前原谅我。那么，能请您带我跳第一支舞吗？」
data.camera: full-body shot, slight frontal angle, complete curtsy visible
data.promptProse: Before the waltz, she gathers the gown in both gloved hands and curtsies toward the off-frame viewer; chandelier light spreads over the violet skirt and her shy face.
data.identityProseOverride: Fern from Frieren: Beyond Journey's End, with purple hair in a formal updo, straight bangs, long sidelocks and violet eyes.
data.animaCaption: She gathers the gown in both hands and curtsies toward the off-frame viewer.
